title: Emerald Coast Tours

services.name: Bike Tours
services.desc: Become a local by touring downtown Pensacola while leisurely riding along the historic streets by Segway. Your experienced local tour guide will lead you through the sites and sounds of Historic Pensacola and a view of breathtaking Pensacola Bay. You will visit many historical sites and neighborhoods, learn fascinating facts about the city of five flags. Tours are ran daily and range from 1 to 2 hours. Learning Pensacola’s history will help you feel more like a local as we locals are proud of our past. Pensacola is the most fascinating city on the Emerald Coast.
